task.name: Inspect_EMT_shade
task.when: Once per shift and after strong wind or rain

step.action: Inspect the shade covering for tears, loose edges, and strong flapping.
Inspect every visible fitting for movement, cracks, and missing fasteners.
Inspect every visible tube and leg for bending, movement, and sinking.
Inspect every visible strap and anchor for looseness, damage, and abrasion.
Inspect the ground for puddles, softened playa, exposed hardware, and blocked paths.

passWhen.criterion: No covering, fitting, tube, leg, strap, or anchor has a visible failure.
No puddle, softened playa, exposed hardware, or blocked path is present.

problem.condition: Any inspection point does not pass.
problem.response: Keep people out of the affected area and tell the Build Lead. Do not adjust or repair the structure.

reasoning.entry: Inspection is separate from repair so a shift worker does not change a wind-loaded structure.
